title: Messages start at the margin, their time at the end
summary: On every platform a message starts at the margin, with no column of times before it, and its time stands at the end of its last line; group messages from history no longer say the sender is not verified. On Android your video keeps its picture while it goes, and on Android and the desktop a file its sender cancelled says so. Android and the desktop get 0.2.80; the iPhone gets TestFlight build 143018 (1.4.34).

changes.title: Messages start at the margin, their time at the end
changes.description: A message no longer starts after a column of times: it starts at the margin, in a group after the tile of its author. Its time, the word edited and the mark of a message of yours stand at the end of its last line, or on a line of their own under it when that line is full; files, voice messages, photos and calls keep theirs at the bottom, at the far edge. Group messages that came from the history of other members no longer carry the yellow line Received from history, sender not verified: they look as any other message, with the tile of their author, which opens that member. Each paragraph keeps its own direction, so a paragraph of figures, such as a phone number or coordinates, reads left to right in an Arabic interface.

changes.title: Android: your video keeps its picture while it goes
changes.description: While a video of yours was being sent, its entry showed a paper clip in place of the video. It now shows the picture of the video, how much is left to send and Cancel, and a tap plays it.

changes.title: A file its sender cancelled says so
changes.description: When the sender cancelled a file before it was whole, the person it went to read The download stopped and could not tell why, or whether anything on their side would bring it back. The entry now says The sender cancelled it, in the muted colour and without Retry. On Android it keeps saying so after a restart; on the desktop until the app is closed.

changes.title: Desktop: a sample of the smiley set
changes.description: Under the smiley set in Settings, Appearance, Conversations, a few emoticons stand as a message shows them with that set, at the size chosen, so the sets can be told apart: the ASCII sets leave typed smileys as text, Classic has pictures of its own, and emojione and Universe are drawn differently.

changes.title: A shorter line for the founder of a group
changes.description: In the group's details, Your role reads You founded the group. You manage its members, moderators and settings.
